text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #20303c

g.text: RSG-HRGV: theory properties and directly matched evidence

text.style: font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #647681

g.text: The statements below characterize expert routing; they do not assert a universal classification gain.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #20303c

g.text: Theorem B.1 Routing regret upper bound

text.style: font-size: 7.1px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #20303c

g.text: For a=p_d(y|x), b=p_m(y|x), g_o=I[a>=b], and a,b>=epsilon:

text.style: font-size: 7.1px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #20303c

g.text: -log p_g(y|x) + log max(a,b) <= |g-g_o| |a-b| / epsilon.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #20303c

g.text: Theorem B.2 Soft-oracle approximation

text.style: font-size: 7.1px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #20303c

g.text: Delta=l_m-l_d, g*=sigmoid(Delta/T_r). The deviation from hard optimal routing

text.style: font-size: 7.1px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #20303c

g.text: is bounded by exp(-|Delta|/T_r); small gaps retain uncertainty instead of forcing a switch.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #20303c

g.text: Theorem B.3 Local gradient isolation

text.style: font-size: 7.1px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #20303c

g.text: L_reg=w BCE(g,g*), w=tanh(|Delta|/T_w). Applying stop-gradient to the regret branch

text.style: font-size: 7.1px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #20303c

g.text: gives dL_reg/dtheta_e=0 for backbone and expert parameters through this branch.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #20303c

g.text: p_g=g p_d+(1-g)p_m, g*=sigmoid((l_m-l_d)/T_r), w=tanh(|l_m-l_d|/T_w)
